text:
tara_cs: Ember-Co pilot hitting sporadic 429s during SDK warmup behind an HTTP/2 proxy. Customer says only on mobile web.
ops-bot: Alert: preflight_concurrency_spike tenant=ember-co count=11 :warning:
ken_se: can you share a short trace and headers?
tara_cs: pasted trimmed trace: ```[2026-03-21T11:02:11Z] client stream=1 preflight start
[2026-03-21T11:02:11Z] token issued ttl=12s id=tokA
[2026-03-21T11:02:11Z] client stream=2 preflight start
[2026-03-21T11:02:11Z] stream=2 saw token stale -> refresh -> tokB
[2026-03-21T11:02:11Z] gateway validated both streams separately -> counted 2 preflights -> 429
```
tara_cs: header dump shows both Authorization and custom x-client-token being sent on separate streams.
sam_sdk: root cause likely: short ephemeral TTL (12s) + no singleflight across concurrent streams + proxy multiplexing. SDK fix ideas: in-memory singleflight per token hash for 500ms, add jitter before refresh, and recommend TTL >=45s for mobile.
ken_se: small patch sounds fine. Can we ship a quick canary?
sam_sdk: will open PR with singleflight map + opt-in flag collapseRefresh=true. Prototype link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/831
leo_infra: infra mitigation: consider treating concurrent streams from same TLS session as single preflight for quota calc (best-effort). That needs careful limits and an RFC. Short-term we can raise tenant preflight concurrency from 8->30 for 12h if CS approves.
tara_cs: customer on tight pilot timeline. Please apply temporary bump, ticket INF-7510 created. I'll coordinate comms.
ops-bot: Note: quota overrides will be audited and may affect billing events.
sam_sdk: also recommend server-side header priority: prefer Authorization if both headers present and emit a `X-Duplicate-Token` warning in response for 3 days to help customers find wrappers adding extra headers. I'll file gateway RFC.
ken_se: once SDK canary out, CS will ask customer to test and confirm metrics stable for 6h. Backport to 2.x after canary validated.
tara_cs: plan set. tagging owners: @sam_sdk (PR), @leo_infra (quota), @ken_se (SDK reviewer), tara_cs (CS). Closing when metrics stable. Thanks!
